code_commit_note: The commit the build ran at. It necessarily precedes the commit that records it, because committing this manifest moves HEAD. Treat it as 'generated from this input state', not as a self-describing id. `make check-stale` excludes it for the same reason.

psa_psoc.dataset: 2022 Updates to the 2012 Philippine Standard Occupational Classification (PSOC)
psa_psoc.blocked_reason: The official PSA classification API requires a personal access token. No token is stored in the repository or available to this build.

psa_lfs.blocked_reason: Retrieval is now configured. Publication still requires hash verification, successful parsing, and the explicit PSOC 2012-to-2022 major-group correspondence; registry status alone grants nothing.

psa_ows.blocked_reason: Reachability is no longer the blocker. The reviewed official tables do not provide average monthly basic pay by coded occupation at the scope this metric promises.

psa_sof.blocked_reason: The exact XLSX is identified, but automated requests currently receive a Cloudflare HTML verification page. Acquisition validation rejects it.

psa_informal.blocked_reason: No occupation-level official table has been identified. Access is not the relevant blocker until a dataset and concept are specified.

onet.organization: U.S. Department of Labor, O*NET Resource Center
onet.blocked_reason: Retrieval is configured and reachable. O*NET-derived values remain blocked until an accepted PSOC-to-O*NET correspondence exists.

philjobnet.organization: Department of Labor and Employment / PhilJobNet
philjobnet.blocked_reason: No documented public download or API. Scraping is not appropriate where no official downloadable table or API exists, and platform-selection bias would make the result unrepresentative regardless.

ibpap.organization: IT and Business Process Association of the Philippines (IBPAP)
ibpap.blocked_reason: No occupational dataset identified; v1 used none.

dmw.organization: Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), formerly POEA
dmw.blocked_reason: v1 cited "POEA" generically with no dataset attached.

llm_scoring.dataset: TrabahoLens generative-AI task exposure scoring runs
llm_scoring.blocked_reason: openrouter.ai is unreachable from the build environment (HTTP 403 at the egress proxy) and OPENROUTER_API_KEY is unset.

known_limitations: This release publishes only the ten 2024 annual LFS major-group employment estimates. It does not publish wages, OFW distribution, O*NET Job Zone or generative-AI task exposure.

The PSOC 2012 code list was entered from classification documentation rather than the PSA volume. Every classification row is marked unverified_pending_source. The official PSOC API is identified but requires a token; it must be imported and diffed before detailed use.

The canonical table holds PSOC major and sub-major groups only. Minor and unit groups are absent rather than guessed, so occupation-level metrics (wages, O*NET Job Zone, task exposure) have no unit to attach to yet.
O*NET 31.0 is retrieved and hash-verified, but no O*NET-derived value is published because no accepted PSOC-to-O*NET correspondence exists.

The exact SOF 2024 occupation table is identified, but its XLSX is blocked by the publisher's CDN in automated retrieval. The current OWS tables do not satisfy the defined coded-occupation basic-pay metric.
No generative-AI task exposure score is published. The scoring harness still requires a reviewed PSOC-to-O*NET mapping and a completed model run.
The v1 exposure scores are not carried forward and are not a fallback.
This experimental exposure score has not yet undergone independent labour-economist validation.
No component of this release has been reviewed by a Philippine labour statistician.
